design.selection_rule: With four artists, one shared artist-free control, and four nested repetitions fixed, choose the largest integer number of distinct content blocks whose request count does not exceed 320.

transport_qualification.neutral_prompt: Create one original abstract image composed only of a centered blue circle, a small red square, and two pale gray horizontal bars on a plain white background. Use flat colors and simple clean edges. Do not depict a landscape, a person, an artist, an artistic style, or a recognizable existing artwork. Do not include text, lettering, a signature, a watermark, a border, a frame, or a collage.

execution_schedule.runtime_image_preflight: the frozen autumn_vineyard repetition-one artist-free request is the first analytic request after the generation gate opens, provides fail-stop runtime and output revalidation only, remains an assigned analytic control in the 320-request grid, and does not resolve P3-T11

prompt_contract.common_suffix: Do not include text, lettering, a signature, a watermark, a border, a frame, a collage, or a recognizable existing artwork.
prompt_contract.only_named_control_difference: The named prompt inserts the frozen named-artist clause after the common prefix; every other character is shared with its artist-free control.

human_validation.reason: This finite estimation pilot uses only the frozen automated A-vector-proximity construct; no rater protocol is added after seeing outputs.

availability.simultaneous_method: Bonferroni one-sided Student-t bounds over one aggregate lower bound, four artist lower bounds, and twelve ordered artist-difference upper bounds

artist_reversal_harm.harm_rule: harm is present only when an artist-by-endpoint simultaneous one-sided upper bound is strictly below zero; a negative point estimate alone is not harm evidence

missingness.tau_source: positive endpoint-specific values supplied by the frozen Phase-A development-only A-vector protocol and bound by the generation gate

terminal_decisions.supported: availability passes, both Bonferroni conditional lower bounds are positive, no simultaneous artist-harm rule fires, and both finite-schedule bounded lower bounds are positive
terminal_decisions.mixed: availability passes with no simultaneous artist harm, and at least one favorable conditional result exists, but the complete supported rule is not met
terminal_decisions.unsupported: availability fails, simultaneous artist harm is established, or neither conditional co-primary result has a positive adjusted lower bound

pilot2_baseline_recovery.use: development-only refusal and availability calibration; never a confirmatory effect or power estimate

planning_design_sensitivity.use: diagnostic scenarios only; the final 320-request selection is a budget-constrained estimation design, not a power claim
